name: HIMPPSY is reflexive and transitive
description: Exercise 4.81: prove that HIMPPSY (see Exercise 4.80) is reflexive and transitive.

elements.text: HIMPPSY is reflexive (identity homomorphisms preserve every port) and transitive (coordinatewise maps compose coordinatewise).
The identity acts coordinatewise through identity port maps.
Composites of coordinatewise surjections are coordinatewise surjections.
